limitations: Only F_3 and rational incidence are classified; no higher-field or geometric-intersection-scheme assertions.
The 2022 classification of minimal blocking point sets is prior work and is not claimed as new.
An implicit earlier treatment of smooth-conic decompositions remains possible; full Coolsaet et al. 2022 text was inaccessible.
scientific_integrity.scope: Distinct geometrically smooth ternary conics over F_3; unordered pairs; projective equivalence of their rational blocking unions.
scientific_integrity.verification: Two standalone exhaustive implementations: 4-arc incidence with projective-orbit closure and quadratic coefficient Hessian determinant.

title: The five projective types of blocking unions of two smooth conics over \(\mathbf F_3\)
